Guidance & outlook: Our H2 - H2 of FY26 and Q4 of FY26 was - you know we were doing monthly losses, some months we lost one and a half crores, some crore even, but like we were burning money.
More frequent reporting - so we have moved to quarterly results and so this will be it going forward.
Every time I give revenue guidance I don't know what happens so I told you all the things - you can extrapolate from there if you want but I am not giving any revenue guidance.
